title: Governed Founder PRD Live Authoring Lane
globalSafetyRules: Implement one subphase at a time.
P90 may only make local founder PRD authoring live after the exact subphase scopes and validates it.

Do not enable provider/model calls, agent dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, project mutation, DB writes, deploy, release, export, package creation, network calls, or provider spend unless that exact lane is separately scoped and validated.

Do not modify projects/**, careloop/**, generated app Sources/Tests, providers/**, tools/**, worker-runtime/**, db/**, prisma/**, migrations/**, deploy/**, release/**, exports/**, packages/**, or .env*.
Do not show DemoApp in full Command Center.
Do not show project/private raw IDs in primary UX.
Do not invent fake working actions.

subphases.objective: Define the governed local founder PRD authoring live lane contract without enabling execution.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.dataShape: P90.1 is contract-only. subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: Preserve existing Business Build and Lite UX. Later P90 UX must show local PRD lane state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner, evidence, activity, and cost without showing runnable project mutation, agent dispatch, provider calls, or raw private IDs.
playwrightTests: No Playwright update in P90.1 because no UI file changes.
P90 Command Center UX subphase must add focused coverage.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm no provider/model calls are enabled.
